guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference data table without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with thead/th; wrap in a scroll container with tabindex=0, role=region and an accessible name (aria-labelledby a caption); keep cell text legible rather than letting columns shrink below legibility.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: compat table has caption, scope=col/row headers, and sits in .table-wrap[tabindex=0][role=region][aria-labelledby=compat-caption]. To keep cells legible it is transposed to browsers-as-rows with nowrap version cells. Exception: no sticky headers or container-query stacking, because the 4x3 table fits at 312px without scrolling.
